name: Logbook
description: Automatic work journal: captures periodic screen snapshots from a paired node and turns them into a reviewable timeline of your day.

captureIntervalSeconds.label: Capture Interval (s)
captureIntervalSeconds.help: Seconds between screen snapshots. Lower is more detailed but uses more disk and analysis tokens.

analysisIntervalMinutes.label: Analysis Window (min)
analysisIntervalMinutes.help: Snapshot window size summarized per analysis batch.

nodeId.label: Capture Node
nodeId.help: Node id or name that provides screen.snapshot. Defaults to the first connected node that supports it.

maxWidth.label: Snapshot Max Width (px)
maxWidth.help: Snapshots are scaled down to this width before storage and analysis.

visionModel.label: Vision Model
visionModel.help: provider/model used to read snapshots; the provider must support structured extraction (the bundled Codex plugin does). Defaults to the first image-capable Codex entry under tools.media.

captureEnabled.label: Capture Enabled
captureEnabled.help: Master switch for the snapshot loop. The timeline UI stays available when off.

retentionDays.label: Frame Retention (days)
retentionDays.help: Snapshots older than this are deleted. Timeline cards are kept.

recommendedPrompts: Help me decide whether to enable Logbook. Check its current state and explain the screen-capture permissions, capture defaults, retention, and which configured models would receive screenshots or derived text. Propose a setup for a device I choose, but do not enable capture, take screenshots, or change settings without my approval.

Help me draft a short standup from a day already tracked in Logbook. Ask which date and audience to use, then summarize recorded accomplishments, context switches, and unresolved work with time references. Call out capture gaps and exclude sensitive details. Do not start new capture or send the standup anywhere.
